sentences.text: For a dual/special rate loan, the pre-payment-charge directions depend on whether the loan is on floating rate at the time of pre-payment.
If the loan is floating at the time of pre-payment and was sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, the pre-payment-charge directions in paragraph 261 apply.
If the case falls outside paragraphs 261(1) and 261(2), any pre-payment charges, if levied, are to be as per the UCB’s approved policy.
On the facts provided, I cannot determine the actual application because the evidence does not show the sanction or renewal date or whether the loan is floating at the time of pre-payment.
